summary: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share on its 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The record date is June 1, 2026, and payment date is June 10, 2026. This is a routine declaration of a regular preferred dividend, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special event terms disclosed. The filing contains only a press release as an exhibit. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics beyond the dividend declaration are present. This is a standard capital return to preferred shareholders with no event-driven angle.
